discrepancies.note: The 19737 figure in .planning/decisions/2026-07-30-civicpatch-api-decision.md came from live civicpatch.org/api/v1 calls. This snapshot counts top-level '- name:' records in the git repo and finds 1203 fewer. Unresolved: the API may serve records not committed to the repo, or count differently. Import sizing should be taken from this snapshot, which is what the importer actually reads.

why_data_source_excluded: data_source/<state>/local/place_*/workflow_context.json is 2781 files / 188 MB - 89% of the clone by size. It holds the scraper's LLM pipeline internals (page content, per-LLM merge steps, review steps), not row provenance. Provenance we rely on (source_urls, updated_at) is carried in the data/ YAML itself, so excluding it loses nothing the importer or an audit needs.
